Neither Donald Trump not Zohran Mamdani have the slightest clue what American exceptionalism means.

Though in fairness I’d expect Mamdani to understand it since Stalin coined the term (though not the idea, that honor goes to De Tocqueville or maybe Werner Sombart). I mean in the debate that provoked Stalin to invoke the “heresy of American exceptionalism” Mamdani would definitely have sided with Stalin over Lovestone.
